step1.name: Heat-set insert pull-out (Fable C1 / #2 M4)
passes: M3 (Ø4.0 × 4.0 and × 6): mean ≥ 1.0 kN, lowest of 3 ≥ 0.8 kN (the 1.0 kN the repo assumed: rnd/joints.py, roll_inline.md). For scale: an M3 tightened to 0.5 N·m already pulls ≈ 833 N
M4 (Ø5.6 × 5.7 and × 8): mean ≥ 1.5 kN, lowest ≥ 1.2 kN (2 × the 750 N M4 preload the repo tightens to, cartridge_m.FLANGE_LOAD, so a seat cap or strap can take its working load on top)
torque-out: no insert spins below 2 × its build torque (M3 1.0 N·m, M4 1.2 N·m)
M5 (Ø6.4 × 10, belt-roll fallback only, roll.PINCH): ≥ 3.0 kN; print it only if `PIP_ROLL_DRIVE=belt` comes back

step1.name: Bolted 4-ear cartridge flange (D24 v2, Neon #2 F2)
passes: fresh, 4 × ISO 4762 M4 × 12 at 0.6 N·m (≈ 750 N each): no slip at **16.5 N·m** (1.5 × the 11 N·m GIM6010 peak), 10 × each way, 1 min each (a witness line across flange and plate moves ≤ 0.1 mm at r 48)
fresh breakaway torque recorded → μ = T_slip / (4 × 0.75 kN × r 48 mm); the model's 43 N·m is μ 0.3 (the 50 kg luggage scale at r 100 reaches 49 N·m; if it does not slip, record > 49)
tipping: no 0.05 mm feeler enters at any ear under **16.1 N·m** bending (1.5 × the 10.7 N·m direct-stage case, 3 g + the belt pull on the motor bearing; the model opens at 33 N·m with 30 % preload)
after 72 h at 50 °C on the P2S bed (preload only): no slip at **13 N·m** (the 30 %-retained friction the flange rows assume, 1.18 × the peak); each ear screw's breakaway torque recorded
one spare ear torqued to 1.2 N·m (2 × the preload): the nut does not pull into its pocket, the pocket floor does not crack

step1.name: D26 drive stub on the GIM output (Fable #2 M3)
passes: (a) tilt stiffness of the output (secant 0 → 9.8 N·m, the housing's own tilt subtracted) **≤ 18 kN·m/rad** (≈ 5.4 N·m per arcmin), i.e. ≥ 1.8′ of tilt at 9.8 N·m (3.2 mm of spot travel on the optical lever at 3 m; 11 µm on a dial at r 20): then the hinged design stands (fatigue 3.13×). Stiffer: the 0.15 mm swap offset drives the stub to 0.56× (fully rigid), so quote the overhung pinion instead (belts.py STUB_SUPPORT_RULE). Hand model, ESTIMATE
(a) PCD, pilot Ø and thread depth read to ± 0.1 mm (C9 disc + calipers) into cartridge_m.MOTOR['out_pcd'] and belt_stage.STUB; the thread depth ≥ 4 mm for M3 × 6 under a 1.8 mm counterbore

(b) on the dummy output: no slip (witness ≤ 0.05 mm at r 17) at **16.5 N·m**, 10 × each way, with a **360 N** radial pull at the flange (the motor bearing's share of the 1158 N shaft load at the peak, belts.md hinged); breakaway of each screw ≥ its build torque after (the model holds 27.2 N·m: μ 0.2 × 8 × 1.0 kN × r 17, 2.47×)
(c) 1b, on the rig: the drive at its 11 N·m peak against the hard stop, 10 ×: no slip (witness mark)
